name: electron-codex-bridge
description: Connect Codex to an Electron app through a local MCP bridge, Electron main-process HTTP bridge, and Chrome DevTools Protocol.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and drive local Electron apps from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds MCP tools for Chrome DevTools Protocol targets and a local Electron main-process bridge so Codex can inspect windows, invoke explicit app handlers, evaluate renderer state in development, and capture BrowserWindow screenshots.
defaultPrompt: List Electron windows and CDP targets.
Invoke my Electron bridge health check.
